# PROJECT_MEMORY — Material-X three-species accommodation (demo fixture)

## Project / 项目
Material-X three-species accommodation 三物种容纳

## Species / 物种
A, B, C

## Core tasks / 核心任务
single-species dissolution 单物种溶解; multi-species accommodation 多物种容纳;
cavity free volume 空腔自由体积; species clustering 物种聚集;
host relaxation 基体弛豫; electronic mechanism 电子机制

## Current stage / 当前阶段
three-species accommodation classification frozen 三物种分类已冻结;
electronic mechanism pending 机制待做

## Main findings / 主要结论
三物种容纳遵循连续尺度依赖响应演化 (continuous scale-dependent response evolution),
不是三个分立模式 (not three discrete modes)
- Vcav 是每个缺陷计算的有效体积描述符, 不是 intrinsic van der Waals radius
- 电子机制 electronic mechanism: 尚未确立
